follow-up time: From recruitment until delivery and postpartum period
outcome: Trial of vaginal birth after cesarean section (VBAC) success rate
cohort: 450 parturient women at Bugando Medical Centre (BMC) (150 with SIPI and 300 with normal inter-pregnancy interval)
finding: Women with a short inter-pregnancy interval had a higher risk of various adverse maternal and perinatal outcomes, including PROM, anemia, VBAC failure, PPH, preeclampsia, SGA, low birth weight, preterm delivery, and low Apgar score.
